description: Get calendar view of shifts grouped by staff or participant. PRIMARY ENDPOINT for finding shifts attached to a NAMED PERSON. Returns shift occurrences for a date range, grouped by either staff or client participants. Recurring shifts are expanded. Call TWICE in parallel — once with groupBy=staff and once with groupBy=participant — to find shifts regardless of which role the person plays.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start of date range as full UTC ISO datetime (inclusive).

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End of date range as full UTC ISO datetime (inclusive).

parameters.name: groupBy
parameters.description: Group results by staff (default — each item is a staff member with their shifts) or participant (each item is a client participant with their shifts).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Items per page.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Optional case-insensitive search by staff or participant name (first / last / preferred).
